Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you confirm
you're comfortable continuing?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please describe in your own words what happened at the parking lot.
A: I was pulling out of a space near the store entrance. It was a busy afternoon and the lot was crowded. I had just
started backing out when another vehicle came down the row and clipped the rear quarter panel of my car.
Q: How fast were you moving when the impact occurred?
A: Very slowly, maybe a few miles an hour. I was checking my mirrors and I'd barely rolled back.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?
A: Not really. I caught a glimpse of something white right before the impact, but I didn't have time to react.
Q: Did you notice any injuries at the scene?
A: I felt fine right after, just a little shaken. But by the next morning my neck was stiff and the pain started radiating
into my shoulders. I've had headaches since then too.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the following day. They diagnosed whiplash and gave me a neck brace and some
medication. I've also started physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Did you have any prior neck or back problems?
A: No, nothing that required treatment. I had normal activity levels before this.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Just that I want to make sure my medical bills and car repairs are covered. I've been missing work because of the
pain.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you shortly.
A: Okay, thanks.
</page>
